Based on a careful comparison of the two screenshots, here are the differences found:

1.  **Header "7-Day Trial" Button Text:** In Image 1, the button clearly reads **"7-Day Trial"**. In Image 2, the text on this button is blurred or obscured (appearing as "7-Day T...al").
2.  **Header "Add On" Icon:** The icon next to "Add On" in the top navigation has changed. Image 1 shows an **"M" inside a circle**. Image 2 shows a **play button (triangle) inside a circle**.
3.  **Cookie Preferences Popup Position/Visibility:** The "Cookie preferences" popup is present in both images but has shifted slightly or its visibility state differs. In Image 1, it is positioned lower and further to the right, partially obscuring the search bar and gallery tiles below. In Image 2, it is positioned higher and more to the left, sitting cleanly above the search bar area.

**Summary of unchanged elements:**
*   Main hero text ("Rodin", "Gen-2.5 Agent-Ready", and the quote).
*   Central workspace UI (Image to 3D box, sidebar tools, Generate button, model settings).
*   Bottom section headers ("ASSET", "EXPLORE") and the "Featured" tag.
*   Overall layout, color theme, and background.
